experiments.scope: The executed Phase C: the embedded enumeration subspace S' of the Phase B output, its fixed chunk-major Gray order, and the index of the first collision. Every trial regenerates the same pair.
experiments.hypothesis: The element of S' at the stated enumeration index and its partner under the message difference alpha_0 are two distinct 135-byte messages with equal sha3-256-r5 digests; hence Phase C examines at most INDEX + 1 pairs.
